title: Throughput Fingerprint Beacon for CI PR Gating
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a deterministic throughput fingerprinting harness ("Beacon") that produces compact, comparable fingerprints of tokens/sec and p95 latency for a given PR commit. The Beacon will run inside CI as an optional PR gate that computes a run-level fingerprint (statistical sketch + meta signals) and compares it to a stored baseline. If the delta exceeds configurable tolerances we fail the gate. The goal is to reduce false positives from noisy single-metric thresholds and allow quick triage of regressions with contextual artifacts (time-series, kernel/host metrics, config hash).
acceptance_criteria: Beacon runs reproducibly in CI for a representative set of workloads and emits a fingerprint artifact (JSON + compact sketch) for each run.
Fingerprint comparison service can fetch baseline by model+seq-dist+commit-tag and produce a pass/fail decision within the CI job time budget (<= 10m extra).
Gate rules support configurable tolerances: relative tokens/sec drop, absolute p95 increase, and a composite anomaly score that accounts for variance and covariates.
Artifacts (raw traces, CPU/GPU utilization aggregates, kernel selection summary) are uploaded to artifact store and linked from the CI job on failure.
False positive rate on historical PR replay dataset is <= 3% at target sensitivity (catch known regressions from last 6 months).
test_plan: Local dev: docker-compose small-driver runs (./tools/beacon/run_local.sh --profile=chat-short) to produce fingerprint.json and artifacts tarball.
CI smoke: add optional job 'beacon-smoke' to PR pipeline that runs the harness against small synthetic set (10k tokens) and records artifact; validate baseline fetch and compare logic.
Regression verification: replay a curated set of 200 historical PRs (from perf-regressions dataset) to measure TP/FN/FPR and tune composite thresholds.
Stress run: run beacon in parallel across 8 c5-like runners to validate artifact upload and CI budget scaling.
Manual validation: developer can run ./tools/beacon/compare.py --baseline <tag> --candidate fingerprint.json to generate human-readable diff and plot (png) for triage.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (opt-in): expose job as optional PR check for runtime team for 2 sprints; collect signal and false positives.
Phase 2 (shadow): enable automatic runs on all PRs but only log decisions to perf-dashboard; surface alerts to eng-leads.
Phase 3 (gate): convert to blocking PR gate for commits to main/runtime when sensitivity validated.
Backout: gate can be disabled per release via feature flag 'beacon_gate=false' and manual override label 'perf-bypass'.
architecture_notes: Beacon components: lightweight driver (replay generator + traffic schedule), metrics collector (p95, tokens/sec, kernel-metadata), fingerprint synthesizer (quantile sketches + signal summary), comparator service (fetch baseline, bootstrap statistical test, composite score), artifact uploader (S3-like), CI integration wrapper. Use existing runtime perf hooks for kernel selection and KV cache warmup to minimize measurement noise.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Maya Patel: Initial ticket created. Prototype driver implemented that replays three canonical traces and emits a raw tokens/sec time series. Need to add sketching layer and CI wrapper.

2026-03-12 - Omar Ruiz: Implemented sketch serializer (t-digest + count) and lightweight comparator. Observed run-to-run variance on short traces; plan to include KV warmup and randomized jitter removal to stabilize p95.

2026-03-14 - Lina Chen (PM): Reviewed prototype results. Concern about CI cost if run on every PR. Suggest opt-in + shadow rollout, and add sampling policy (run on 25% of PRs by default) during Phase 2.
notes_on_flakiness_mitigation: Key mitigations: canonical trace selection tied to production seq-dist, mandatory KV cache priming, discard first N tokens as warmup, aggregate across 3 independent runs and use median-based sketch comparison, and require composite anomaly to persist across two CI runs before failing gate. Also provide an allowlist label 'perf-override' for emergency merges.
